item.title: Leaf Reader 1.7.9
item.description:
• 改进 PDF 朗读：自动学习并跳过重复页眉和页脚行。
  • 页码和页脚文字在同一视觉行时会整行跳过，避免 TTS 读出页脚。
  • 增加启动耗时诊断，并延迟部分朗读组件初始化，让日常启动更轻。
  • 补充 PDF 页脚过滤和启动耗时相关回归测试。

• Improved PDF read-aloud by learning and skipping repeated header and footer rows.
  • Footer text and page numbers on the same visual row are skipped together during TTS.
  • Added launch performance diagnostics and delayed part of speech setup for lighter everyday startup.
  • Added regression coverage for PDF footer filtering and launch timing.
